verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw is a law firm that sells legal advisory services, not a software product or platform where a user's data is stored and could be retained or deleted, so user-controlled data retention is a category error for this kind of offering. Its Data Protection & Privacy practice advises clients on compliance (DPDP Act, GDPR). That is legal advice about other companies' data handling, not a retention or deletion control the firm provides to users, so it cannot be credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
